title: Sean Kirkpatrick's background at Brookhaven and Oak Ridge
place_text: Brookhaven Lab, New York; Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Tennessee

tellings.quote: he worked at Oakridge National Laboratory you know clear Atomic site

plain: The government scientist Sean Kirkpatrick once worked at the nuclear research labs at Brookhaven in New York and at Oak Ridge National Laboratory in Tennessee, which Michels calls "a clear atomic site". Michels points this out himself, apparently to note that Kirkpatrick's career runs through the US nuclear establishment.
